attempts.summary: Deployed a systemd-managed Python inventory app on node1 serving JSON inventory data over TCP port 8181, opened the firewalld port, and confirmed the service works with SELinux in Enforcing mode (process runs as unconfined_service_t, no AVC denials). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a pre-restart baseline (boot ID, service/port/HTTP state), triggered systemctl reboot, confirmed the connection dropped then recovered, verified the boot ID changed, and re-verified SELinux Enforcing, service active, port listening, no AVC denials, and correct inventory data served post-restart.
